1.consolidated_definition: Grano del café caído en el suelo por varias razones, sin la cubierta exterior; puramente en su pepita.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Coffee bean that has fallen to the ground for various reasons, without its outer covering; purely in its pit or kernel.
